metadata.method: Read-only static inspection of the supplied committed snapshot; no repository tests, models, probes, providers or harnesses executed.
metadata.evidence_policy: Recorded local runs are historical artifacts, not observations reproduced in this audit. Design coverage, decisions, implementation qualification and independent acceptance are separate.
metadata.ranking_policy: Ordinal within each ledger; prerequisite reach, irreversible-risk reduction and cheap decisive evidence take priority. Not an Owner release-cut decision, technology selection or execution authorization.
metadata.future_test_policy: Every next test is a proposed discriminating test, not executed or authorized here. Live credentials, provider calls, destructive targets, spend and counsel contact remain separately gated.
metadata.comparison_policy: Eligible rivals preserve the identical required capability, authority, safety, accounting, evidence, platform and release gates. Deliberately nonconforming cases are retained separately as negative controls, never selectable alternatives. Proposed rivals remain unexecuted/unselected.
